coursesMeta.headline: Teaching the systems I actually build
coursesMeta.intro: Practical courses drawn from production work rather than from tutorials. Each one is built around the decisions engineers get asked to make, not around syntax.
coursesMeta.notice: These courses are in development. Join the list and I will send the details when each one opens.

courses.title: SFCC Backend Engineering
courses.subtitle: Commerce Cloud past the tutorials
courses.summary: Build the parts of a Salesforce Commerce Cloud storefront that carry money. Cart, checkout, payments, jobs and the OCAPI/SCAPI surface.

courses.title: Java Backend with Spring Boot
courses.subtitle: From domain model to deployed service
courses.summary: Design the domain first, then build a Spring Boot service around it, with persistence, auth, tests and failure handling decided before the first endpoint.

courses.title: System Design for Working Engineers
courses.subtitle: HLD and LLD you can defend
courses.summary: Capacity estimation, service boundaries, storage choices and consistency trade-offs, taught as decisions with costs rather than as diagrams to memorise.

courses.title: DSA Patterns That Transfer
courses.subtitle: Recognise the shape, not the question
courses.summary: The recurring patterns behind interview problems and real work, covering linear structures, recursion, trees, graphs and dynamic programming.
